title: 3796. Find Maximum Value in a Constrained Sequence

examples.explanation: The sequence a = [0, 2, 4, 1, 2, 6, 2, 1, 1, 3] satisfies the given constraints (a[3] <= 1 and a[8] <= 1). The maximum value in the sequence is 6.
The sequence a = [0, 3, 3, 2, 6, 8, 11, 12] satisfies the given constraints (a[3] <= 2). The maximum value in the sequence is 12.

hints: The problem can be solved greedily.
Any restriction at index i also indirectly limits nearby positions due to the cumulative diff bounds.
The maximum possible value at each index is the minimum of all bounds propagated from the left and from the right.
Once all upper bounds are fixed, the answer is simply the maximum value among them.
